study type: Individual participant data meta-analysis of 39 cohorts
outcome: Small for gestational age at birth
Large for gestational age at birth
cohort: The study included 265,270 births from various cohorts across Europe, North America, and Oceania.
finding: Higher maternal pre-pregnancy BMI and gestational weight gain were associated with increased risks of gestational hypertensive disorders, gestational diabetes, and large for gestational age at birth, with obese mothers with high gestational weight gain facing the highest risk of any pregnancy complication.
